description: This file defines template classes for mock object behaviors in Google Mock, specifically NiceMock, NaggyMock, and StrictMock, which modify how uninteresting calls are handled in mock classes.

classes.name: NiceMock
classes.description: A subclass of a mock class that allows uninteresting calls without warnings or errors.

classes.name: NaggyMock
classes.description: A subclass of a mock class that warns when uninteresting calls occur.

classes.name: StrictMock
classes.description: A subclass of a mock class that treats all uninteresting calls as errors.

methods.name: NiceMock
methods.description: Constructs a NiceMock object, enabling uninteresting call allowance.

methods.name: NaggyMock
methods.description: Constructs a NaggyMock object, enabling warnings for uninteresting calls.

methods.name: StrictMock
methods.description: Constructs a StrictMock object, enabling errors for uninteresting calls.
